content:
Updates user authorizations for accessing a Tenable Vulnerability Management instance. Use the
endpoint to grant and revoke authorizations.
Note: You cannot update authorizations for the current user.
For background information about managing user authorizations, see Manage User Access
Authorizations in the Tenable Vulnerability Management User Guide.
Requires the Administrator [64] user role. See Roles.
AUTHORIZATIONS:
cloud
PATH PARAMETERS
string <uuid>
The UUID of the user. To determine the UUID, use the GET /users endpoint.
REQUEST BODY SCHEMA:
application/json
boolean
Indicates whether API access is authorized for the specified user.
boolean
Indicates whether user name and password login is authorized for
the specified user.
boolean
Indicates whether SSO with SAML is authorized for the specified
user.
boolean
Indicates whether or not two-factor authentication is required for
the specified user.
